# Vulkan Memory Allocator (VMA)

Vendored from Vulkan SDK 1.4.357.0 (`Include/vma/vk_mem_alloc.h`).

- License: MIT (see the header text)
- Upstream: https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/VulkanMemoryAllocator

- `VMA_IMPLEMENTATION` is compiled once in

- Do not edit this file in place; update it by re-vendoring a pinned SDK/upstream version.
